title: Design System: Site Safety Watch Console

shadows.name: hazard-lift
shadows.purpose: Lifts the active hazard stamp over camera evidence.

motion.name: evidence-enter
motion.purpose: Reveals a newly observed event once.

components.name: Hazard Stamp
components.description: The one urgent overlay on camera evidence.
components.css: .ds-hazard-stamp { display:inline-block; padding:13px 16px 12px; color:#140904; background:#ff6a32; border-radius:7px; box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.42); font-family:ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,sans-serif; } .ds-hazard-stamp span { display:block; font-size:2rem; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:-.035em; } .ds-hazard-stamp strong { display:block; margin-top:4px; font-size:.75rem; letter-spacing:.07em; }

components.name: Approved Status
components.css: .ds-approved { display:inline-flex; padding:3px 8px; border:1px solid #28735f; border-radius:5px; color:#c4ffed; background:#12362f; font:800 .64rem ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.03em; } .ds-approved:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #9dc6ff; outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview: The console treats each detection as a record with evidence, time, status and human custody. Matte carbon surfaces reduce glare while a single safety orange mark pulls the active hazard forward.
keyCharacteristics: Status is written as text and reinforced with color.
New data moves once; unchanged data remains still.

rules.name: The Earned Color Rule
rules.body: Orange, amber and teal appear only when a real event state earns them.

rules.name: The Five-Second Rule
rules.body: Product name, active hazard, zone and event status remain readable before any supporting copy.

rules.name: The Flat Record Rule
rules.body: Evidence rows and detail fields use rules, never generic card shadows.

dos: Do make the newest unresolved evidence immediately visible.
Do show honest loading, empty, unavailable and offline states.
Do use tabular figures for time, confidence and measured values.
Do preserve the camera, ledger and selected record at recording breakpoints.
donts: Don't invent metrics, status or evidence.
Don't add decorative gradients, glows or stock imagery.
Don't turn the console into a grid of equal metric cards.
